messages.subject: For John Cameron / Boyden Aberdeen | Executive Candidate | Mining, ESG & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Boyden Aberdeen Team,

I am following up through Boyden's official UK office address after my direct message to John Cameron was rejected by the recipient mail gateway. I would be grateful if this introduction could be routed to John and the appropriate partner covering mining, natural resources, sustainability, external affairs and senior international leadership mandates.

I currently serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social responsibility, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and cross-functional execution in a major gold-mining environment. My career spans more than 12 years across multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations.

I am internationally mobile and interested in Director, Head, Country, External Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Business Development, Operations and related senior leadership mandates. My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

I would welcome a discussion with the relevant Boyden partner regarding current or forthcoming international mandates aligned with this background.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
